author: Seung Wook
problem: daily_km lists the kilometres a hiker walked on each day of a trek, starting with day 0. legs is a list of (first_day, last_day) pairs. Return the total distance walked in each leg, from its first day through its last day.
bug_description: Uses prefix[last] - prefix[first] instead of prefix[last + 1] - prefix[first], so the last day of every leg is left out.

comments.accurate: Kilometres walked in each leg, using running totals of the daily distances
comments.wrong_behavior: Kilometres for each leg; a leg's last day is its rest day, so it adds no distance
comments.wrong_location: Leg lookup verified; check the running totals start from zero
